title: NodeV2
description: A fork choice node, identified by its block root and payload status.

slot.description: The slot of the beacon block.

block_root.description: The hash tree root of the beacon block.

payload_status.description: `pending`: the parent of this block's `empty` and `full` nodes. `empty`: this block without its execution payload. `full`: this block with its execution payload.

parent_root.description: The block root of the parent fork choice node. For Gloas `empty` and `full` nodes, this equals `block_root`, pointing to the same block's `pending` node. Otherwise, it is the beacon block's `parent_root`.

anyOf.description: The payload status of the parent fork choice node. Null if the parent is not retained in the fork choice tree.

weight.description: The raw stored weight of this fork choice node in Gwei.

execution_block_hash.description: For `full` nodes, the block's execution payload hash. For Gloas `pending` and `empty` nodes, the bid's `parent_block_hash`.

payload_attester_count.description: Number of PTC positions with a recorded vote.

payload_availability_yes_count.description: Number of PTC positions voting that the payload was received on time.

payload_data_availability_yes_count.description: Number of PTC positions voting that the blob data is available.
